name: LibraryModel sources
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Library's window: LibraryCatalog (photos, collections with counts, the selected collection, sort order, the loupe's photo, stepping and position), the grid's selection on SuiteKernel's Selection (LibrarySelectionAdapter: a click's pick through the display order, the arrow move, select), PhotoItem with its sort orders, keywords, title, caption and camera details (PhotoDetails: CameraDetails cleaned from Exif, CameraField and the Info tab's camera rows for the selected photos),metadata edits on the selected photos with mixed values (PhotoMetadata, PhotoFlag) and the metadata inspector's accessibility identifiers (MetadataInspectorID), 60 seeded sample photos and the launch fixtures (LibraryFixtures: shoot, cameras with invented camera details and keywords, large), and LibraryThumbnailCache (the grid's held thumbnails, pending requests and size bucket, reading the catalog without changing it and returning failures as availability changes for applyThumbnailFailures), and the status contract (LibraryStatusRow and LibraryStatusPill: the row under the content with its count, selection, cell size or loupe zoom and place, import, render, save and Preview data pills; LibraryInspectorHeader: the inspector's title and facts), and the export contract: export names (ExportNaming+Kernel, an adapter onto SuiteModel's UniqueFileNames) and the Library-local export formats, presets and XMP sidecar (ExportFormats, ExportPresets, ExportSidecar) with the catalog's export methods and runner (LibraryExport), and the sidecar contract (SidecarContracts: SidecarWriting with its unconnected live default, SidecarFields and SidecarWrite; FakeSidecars in memory) on LibraryServices, and the metadata-more slots later slices fill (LibraryKeywords: KeywordState and the keyword edits, with keywordHelp real; title and caption on PhotoMetadata; XMPSidecar: the sidecar packet, name and write plan; PhotoSearch: the search field's value), and the menu and key actions (LibraryAction with the catalog's help and run, refusing with the menu's reason as a LibraryRefusal: LibraryActions), and those actions as SuiteKernel command specs with the catalog's history (LibraryCommandCatalog), and the catalog file on SuiteKernel's DocumentSession and VersionedJSON probe (LibrarySession+Kernel), and the headless document for the CLI and MCP (LibraryHeadless: a .library zip of catalog.json and its images, import, save, and the picks exported as PNG), and the file-flow adapter (LibraryFileFlow+Kernel: the catalog as a SuiteDocumentHost and FileFlowTarget, always open, placing the photo kinds it imports and handing other apps' documents to them), and filters and collections (LibraryFilter: flags, rating rule, labels and Hide Rejected over the selected collection, with the filter bar's methods and summary; LibraryCollections: collections you make and smart collections from the filter, each edit one undo step, and the collections.json codec, restore and set-aside notice).
